label: Monday
meaning: The day of the week that comes after Sunday.

label: Tuesday
meaning: The day of the week that comes after Monday.

label: Wednesday
meaning: The day of the week that comes after Tuesday.

label: Thursday
meaning: The day of the week that comes after Wednesday.
exampleUsage: We have an activity on Thursday.

label: Friday
meaning: The day of the week that comes after Thursday.
exampleUsage: Friday is the last school day of the week.

label: Saturday
meaning: The day of the week that comes after Friday.
exampleUsage: We stay at home on Saturday.

label: Sunday
meaning: The day of the week that comes after Saturday.
exampleUsage: Sunday is the last day of the week.

label: Today
exampleUsage: Today is a good day to learn.
